description:
Our top direct client is looking for a Business Intelligence Developer. 
 The client is a Fortune 50 multi-billion dollar revenue generating organization with a spectrum of products and services throughout major operating businesses 
 Job Responsibilities: 
 Responsible for hands on development using SSIS, SSRS and T-SQL. 
 Responsible for developing and documenting the systems, processes and logic required to expose the existing data sets in the warehouse to end users for reporting and analysis purposes 
 Optimize dtsx packages and rdl reports for performance and improvement opportunities. 
 Ensure the quality, consistency and security of company data and data warehouse systems. 
 Utilize Source Control, bundle dependencies to make a deliverable unit of code, Build and deploy via a Continuous Integration framework. 
 Use a test driven design methodology. 
 Participate in an AGILE process. 
 
 Required Skills: 
 Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Information Technology 
 Knowledge of Data Warehouse and BI Reporting concepts 
 Knowledge of Logical and Physical Database Design 
 Knowledge of SSIS and SSRS 
 Knowledge of SQL and T-SQL 
 Required Experience: 
 3-5 years SSIS Development experience 
 3-5 years SSRS Development experience 
 3-5 Experience with writing and debugging SQL Server stored procedures 
 3-5 Experience with Databases – OLTP and OLAP
